messages:
naomi: Quick kickoff — we need a field-ready battlecard + webinar landing copy that sells the bench story without heavy slides. Focus: one strong benchmark headline, three 10s rebut snippets, and exact inbound tags for SDR routing. :mag:

charles: For the headline: 'Real-world benches: consistent p99 under load + lower per-token spend' — but shorter. Maybe: 'Predictable latency, predictable cost.'

felix: I like that. Add a parenthetical example line: 'e.g., 30% cost delta on 4k seqs in our tests' — but flag as example only.

maria: SDR play: need 3x quick reply templates they can copy/paste after the webinar. Plain language, <20 words each.

ravi: Routing rules proposal: webinar form fields: company, size, deployment preference [Hosted/Dedicated/Private], compliance needs, bench interest [yes/no]. Auto-tags: Dedicated -> "Dedicated interest"; Private -> "Private/VPC"; Compliance -> "Compliance lead"; Bench -> "Bench request". Routing map: Dedicated->AM+SolutionsEng, Private->Enterprise-SE+Security, Compliance->Security+AE, Bench->Growth SDR+PM.

naomi: Good. Also include escalation: if "Bench request" + company size > 500, auto-flag AE for priority outreach.

charles: SDR one-liners (first pass):
- vs managed cloud: "Great for proofs. For steady production, you need runtime controls (caching, fallbacks) and clear unit economics."
- vs LLM APIs: "APIs are quick, but they don't offer deployment flexibility or cost levers for heavy traffic."
- vs infra vendors: "GPUs are table stakes. We provide the runtime, rollout tools, and observability you actually use."

felix: tighten: make them less marketing-y, more consultative. e.g., replace "we provide" with "we ship" for brevity.

maria: also add a short rebut for "cloud has global infra": "Global infra is helpful; our smart routing + model fallbacks keep SLAs intact while cutting unit cost."

naomi: Good call. For the landing page CTA, let's offer: "Request a 48hr bench vs your stack" and radio choices for what they'd like: "Latency focus / Cost focus / Compliance check / Full bench". That helps SDR triage.

ravi: I'll draft the exact Zapier/Forms rules: incoming form -> add tags based on radio/checks -> create Trello card for AM/SE with prefilled context. Also add an SFDC campaign marker for webinar registrants.

charles: Bench narrative note: include a tiny table screenshot (2 rows) showing seq length vs tokens/sec vs $/1000 tokens to make the cost claim feel concrete. We'll add a one-line model-family caveat.

felix: Slide copy: 1-liner headline, 3 bullets (bench stat, routing/fallbacks, unified runtime), 1-sentence CTA. Keep to one slide + one takeaway handout.

maria: I'll draft the 200-word blog tie-in that mentions a customer vignette (anonymized) where we saved cost and stabilized latency across regions. Will include the CTA and SRD routing note.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording and slides will be posted to #events after the session.

naomi: Timeline: charles to post bench figure by Mon, ravi to publish routing rules + form by Tue, maria to circulate blog draft Wed, felix to drop slide copy Tue EOD. Everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned.

charles: :thumbsup: uploaded placeholder figure to drive (link in thread).

ravi: :thumbsup: will post the routing PR Tue morning.

felix: :thumbsup: starting slide draft now.

maria: :thumbsup: will ping for customer quote approvals.

naomi: Thanks all — i'll assemble the battlecard and push a PR to the marketing repo when the assets land. :rocket:
